tree.heading: Definition of Agency Proceeding.—
tree.text: In this section, the term “agency proceeding” has the meaning given the term in section 551 of this title.

tree.heading: Availability.—
tree.text: Agencies and advisory committees shall make available to any person, at actual cost of duplication, copies of transcripts of any agency proceeding or advisory committee meeting.
